submission.natural_language_explanation: L1/H6 binds a recent demonstrative or anaphoric pronoun and copies it into the residual: at the 1-2 tokens following a demonstrative 'that' (pronoun, or determiner of a bare NP: 'that direction', 'that period', "that's", 'that is', 'that was') or a subject/expletive 'it'/'It' ('it is', 'it seems', 'it becomes possible') its attention concentrates 0.8-1.0 on that pronoun, so its strength |W_O(z - mean z)| peaks at 3.4-3.9 (0.87-1.0 of the unit max) on those following tokens, whatever their own identity (noun, copula or '$' alike). It is weak (about 0.35-0.5 of max) on the pronoun token itself, on complementizer or relative 'that' ('that the', 'that he', 'that failed') and on text with no demonstrative/pronoun/delimiter nearby, while 'this' and 'which' bind in the same positions with visibly smaller value vectors and a closing '$' binds the '$' that opened its inline-math span.
